paragraphs.text: Amid a crowd of sorrows there is a finishing rite to perform, and it happens inside the spreading taste of bliss-essence: even a foul day turns sweet. Because the hymn works both ways — the singer sings it and it sings the singer — the mind looks at itself reflected and drops its fear.
